notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello, Animal Trainers! 🐾

We’re thrilled to announce the latest update for Animal Trainer Simulator, featuring many important changes and improvements to make your gameplay experience even better! 🎉

Key Updates:
Enhanced Graphics and Optimization 🌟 – we’ve refreshed the game’s visuals and improved its performance to provide a smoother and more realistic experience! 🎮✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/d12dd645e1c313b25b3f513dd8c20b486739d749.pngBefore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f095b9c5965bf7e9cd31c4f3497c42c5c0d3a66d.pngAfter




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/a4c350780414e4482c3a98545a9bc042d2f652af.pngBefore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/75b2256e90c7f1abbbbaddc01664b35a19117021.pngAfter




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/93c7610a97ed8e7ee7522a77b1dde2d19bab8950.pngBefore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/47c5f9b3aee38e0d7de1861e0ac67ac0b45ef981.pngAfter




Patch Notes:
🐶 Fixed an issue where a dog's satisfaction wouldn’t increase during playtime.
💧 Fixed collision issues with water in certain areas.
📌 Added the ability to pin required training tasks for each animal.
📧 Improved the email app – added more order details and information.
🐕 Added unique icons for each pet breed.
🐾 Fixed a bug causing dogs to disappear during the attack mini-game (affected all breeds).
🍲 Resolved an issue in the tutorial where the dog wouldn’t eat or drink on its own after loading the game.
🎛️ Improved game loading function from the menu.
🐴 Fixed the trailer floor for horses.
🔄 Corrected horse rotation when entering the trailer.
🛒 Added a shopping cart function in the store, allowing players to add and remove items before purchase.
🏷️ Updated product details in the store – added quantity information and improved price display.
🌍 Corrected translations in the email app and store.
Improved Optimization 🚀 – the game now runs faster and smoother than ever.
Enhanced Visuals 🎨 – Animal Trainer Simulator now looks even better!
🛑 Blocked the ability to enter water.
🛠️ Other minor improvements and fixes.
🐴It is now possible to wash the horse
📉The game's disk space usage has been reduced



Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback, which help us continually improve the game! Jump back in to explore all the new features, and let us know what you think. 🌟🐾

See you in the game!
The Animal Trainer Simulator Team 🐾

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
📢 New Update in Animal Trailer Simulator!

Patch notes:


 Disabled mouse cursor in minigames that don’t require it.
 Added visible product quantities in the store and updated prices.
 Improved idle animation of the horse in the trailer.
 Added notifications at the entrances to the training and tournament fields.
 Added map information about training requirements for tournaments.
 Fixed the issue preventing building placement on purchased land after loading the game.
 Added visible land boundaries during construction.
 Improved FOV saving and loading to work across all cameras.
 Fixed the second house with the double-door fridge.
 Disabled the ability to open the tablet while riding the horse.
 Enhanced the dog balancing minigame.
 Resolved the issue with the dog washer where the player could exit during use.
 Implemented translation fixes in minigames, activities, and other UI elements.


Check it out now!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2

Dear Trainers, we have good news for you! 🐴

In the latest update, we’ve fixed the issue with the tutorial task related to the horse. Now you can smoothly complete this stage and continue your animal training adventure!

Thank you for your reports and support. Don’t forget to update your game! 💪

Animal Trainer Simulator Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello, Trainers!

We want to take a moment to sincerely thank you for all your amazing feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. Your dedication and activity are making Animal Trainer Simulator better with every update, and we truly appreciate it!

Here’s what’s coming in the latest patch:

🐴 Fixed the final indicator check in the levade minigame
🏇 Fixed tournament obstacles not registering the animal
🏁 Animal will no longer run after tournaments
🎥 Fixed camera collision while petting
🐕 Improved animations in the barking minigame
🚫 Disabled order cancellation during the tutorial
🏠 Fixed house placement issues
🐾 Fixed unhooking the dog task after washing

Once again, thank you for your ongoing support! Your feedback helps shape the game, and we’re excited for you to enjoy these fixes.



Happy training!
The Animal Trainer Simulator Team

notes.title: PROLOGUE | New Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello Players! 🐕

As you know, the release date of Animal Trainer Simulator: Prologue has almost come, but unfortunately, we have decided to slightly delay the release and the new release date is May 17, 2024, at 4 PM CET 🗓️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202220/Animal_Trainer_Simulator_Prologue/

We need a few extra days to complete and test the localization and to make sure that the upcoming Prologue is fully ready. We believe this decision is for the best and it’ll result in a better experience for the players. 😊 So change your calendars and get ready for the premiere of free Prologue on May 17 at 4 PM CEST. 🐶

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/26429935b1cef94d76e9647800e261d35e82af08.png

To not miss out on any important news we encourage you to add the game to your wishlists on Steam and to join our discord. 👇

See you soon,
Animal Trainer Simulator Team
